case.title: Live agent slice in TypeScript and Python: lost reply + blind retry violates at-most-once (proven by the provider ledger) while two legitimate refunds and an idempotent retry pass; recorded model replay with no upstream reproduces it; changed and truncated recordings diverge explicitly; MCP through the gateway with the official SDK; sandbox Guard shadow agrees with Explore and enforce never dispatches; exact-call approvals; cancellation is not rollback; IP-literal and undeclared-host bypasses blocked; two provider accounts stay separate; a reset that skips the ledger blocks the next trial
